name: Kalecgos in dragon form
shortDescription: Kalecgos in dragon form, represented in the Shattered Sun and Sunwell research story.
body: A TBC Sunwell appearance of the existing Kalecgos character in his true blue-dragon form; it does not replace the elven guise used in later story scenes. This is a theater-specific visual alias of the existing kalecgos record, not a separate character. Original image-generation art; not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, size or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the Burning Crusade patch-2.4 client/model before human review. See docs/research/shattered-sun-sunwell-visual-assets.json.
